penalties.name: The DD Rule
penalties.description: Attempting to draft a player who has already been drafted.

ir_rules: IR slot is for players placed on IR after the draft.
Drafting an IR player counts toward the 19 active spots during the draft.
Post-draft, an IR player can move to the IR slot, opening an active spot for waivers.
When a player is activated from IR, managers must make room on the 19-man active roster or drop the player.

cost_rules.previously_drafted: Kept 4 rounds earlier than original draft position (e.g., 15th round keeper costs 11th round pick).

special_rules.name: Cam Akers Rule
special_rules.description: An inactive/IR player picked up during the season can only be kept if playable during that same league season and started at least once. Inactive stashes with season-ending injuries are ineligible.

keepers.injury_exception: If a declared keeper suffers an injury between declaration and draft, the manager may select an alternative player with immediate notice to the league.

exemptions: A free waiver pickup is granted for any player on a roster who suffers a season-ending injury.

trading.notes: Draft pick trading banned by league vote on 8/17/2025.

end_of_season_fees: Diamond Dog Penalty: $1 per duplicate draft attempt.
Waiver overage fees ($10/pickup over 5 in W1-4; $5/pickup over 2/wk from W5+).
Weekly Low Scorer Fee: $5 per week (Weeks 1-14). Ties result in all tied teams paying $5.

payouts.weekly_high_scorer_weeks: 1-14 (ties pay out to all tied teams)
payouts.playoffs: Top 3 teams payout structure (see league payout settings)

punishments.lowest_total_regular_season_points: Must bring a bottle of Woodford Reserve to next year's draft.
